desktop.notes:
• Click an album: its photos in this folder. Click again: the whole album (every folder + the Library) - the grid gets a coloured frame and the folder name fades. Each click switches between the two; Esc goes back to the folder.
• An album photo whose drive is not connected shows its Library copy instead of an error.
• Leaving an album shows a photo of the folder right away (no leftover error picture).
• Shorter album bar.
• Versions are plain numbers from now on (1.6.0, 1.6.1, ...).
